redCandidate.setup: The public runner receives a verified temporary two-task manifest and only fake adapters. The first Codex baseline task has a validated 2 USD estimate and its fake client throws TimeoutError; every other task costs and spends 0.1 USD.
redCandidate.expected: The failed job writes one redacted timeout artifact retaining 2 USD, skips its second task, and lets the next job observe 8 USD remaining before the unaffected jobs complete.
redCandidate.observed: The public test fails because no artifact has status timeout; the runner records the generic failed status, so the timeout terminal record cannot be found.
redCandidate.failureReason: The generic error catch does not classify TimeoutError and does not reserve the validated estimate before the client invocation, leaving the required terminal state and shared-budget guarantee unimplemented.
